WITH circuit_counts AS (
  SELECT
    c.circuitId,
    c.country,
    COUNT(*) AS race_count
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  WHERE r.date BETWEEN '1978-03-04' AND '2003-03-09'
  GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country
),
with_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    circuitId,
    country,
    race_count,
    1.0 * race_count / AVG(race_count) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS ratio
  FROM circuit_counts
)
SELECT circuitId, country, race_count, ratio
FROM with_ratios
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
